body.Uranus.text: Uranus. Pale blue, and tipped right over on its side. Strange, quiet planet.
body.Uranus.speaker: pilot
body.Uranus.heard: Uranus, pale blue and tipped right over on its side. Strange, quiet planet.

body.Neptune.text: Neptune. That blue... the deepest blue. Fastest winds in the solar system down there.
body.Neptune.speaker: pilot
body.Neptune.heard: Neptune. That blue, the deepest blue, fastest winds in the solar system down there.

body.Pluto.text: Pluto. There's the heart. The Sun's just a bright star from here. We're so far from home.
body.Pluto.speaker: pilot
body.Pluto.heard: Pluto. There's the heart. The sun's just a bright star from here. We're so far from home.

body.Ceres.text: Solaris, Ceres, in the asteroid belt. Those bright spots in the crater are salt.
body.Ceres.speaker: mission
body.Ceres.heard: Solaris, series, in the asteroid build. Those bright spots in the crater are salt.

body.Sun.text: Solaris, you are getting very close to the Sun. Heat shields near limits. Turn away, turn away now.
body.Sun.speaker: mission
body.Sun.heard: Salaris, you are getting very close to the sun, heat shields near limits. Turn away, turn away now.

body.Sun.2.text: The corona... like white fire reaching out into space. Okay. That's close enough. Way close enough.
body.Sun.2.speaker: pilot
body.Sun.2.heard: The corona, like white fire reaching out into space. Okay, that's close enough. Way close enough.

body.Earth.text: Solaris, welcome home. Earth approach. It's good to hear your voice clearly again.
body.Earth.speaker: mission
body.Earth.heard: Solaris, welcome home. Earth approach. It's good to hear your voice clearly again.

body.Earth.2.text: There she is. Home. Blue and white and... alive. Nothing else out there looks like this.
body.Earth.2.speaker: pilot
body.Earth.2.heard: There she is, home, blue and white and alive. Nothing else out there looks like this.

body.Sgr.text: The black hole... light's bending all around it. I don't like this. I really don't like this.
body.Sgr.speaker: pilot
body.Sgr.heard: The black hole, lights bending all around it. I don't like this. I really don't like this.

belt.1.text: Asteroid belt. Funny, in movies it's packed. Out here they're thousands of kilometres apart.
belt.1.speaker: wing
belt.1.heard: asteroid belt. Funny, in movies it's packed. Out here, they're thousands of kilometers apart.

deep.1.text: Look back. That speck of light? That's Earth. Everyone who ever lived... on that little dot.
deep.1.speaker: pilot
deep.1.heard: Look back. That's spec of light, that's earth. someone who ever lived on that little dot.

deep.2.text: Solaris, your signal's taking hours to reach us now. We hear you. You're doing great out there.
deep.2.speaker: mission
deep.2.heard: Solaris, your signal's taking hours to reach us now. We hear you. You're doing great out there.

sky.eclipse.text: Eclipse! The Moon's sliding over the Sun... the light's going strange. Look at the corona.
sky.eclipse.speaker: pilot
sky.eclipse.heard: Eclipse, the moon's sliding over the sun, the light's going strange, look at the corona.

sky.flare.text: Solaris, solar flare in progress. Radiation spike incoming. Expect some static on this channel.
sky.flare.speaker: mission
sky.flare.heard: Solaris Solar flare and progress Radiation spike incoming expect some static on this channel

sky.comet.text: Comet! Look at the tail on that thing! Millions of kilometres long!
sky.comet.speaker: wing
sky.comet.heard: Comment, look at the tail on that thing, millions of kilometers long.

sky.meteors.text: Shooting stars... there's another one. And another. It's raining light tonight.
sky.meteors.speaker: pilot
sky.meteors.heard: Shooting stars, there's another one, and another. It's raining like tonight.

era.1.text: Solaris, you are now seeing the solar system as it was, long before us. Look closely. Nothing here knows we exist yet.
era.1.speaker: mission
era.1.heard: Stellaris, you are now seeing the solar system as it was, long before us. But closely, nothing here knows we exist yet.

cloudout.2.text: And we're out! Blue sky, sun on the wings. Never gets old.
cloudout.2.speaker: wing
cloudout.2.heard: And we're out, blue sky, some on the wings. Hehe, never gets old.

storm.1.text: Whoa, whoa. Lightning off the right side, that's close. Turning away from that cell.
storm.1.speaker: pilot
storm.1.heard: Whoa, whoa, lightning off the right side, that's close. turning away from that cell.

terrain.1.text: Ground! Ground! Pull up, pull up, come on!
terrain.1.speaker: pilot
terrain.1.heard: Ground, ground, pull up, pull up, come on.

terrain.2.text: Oh my god. Okay. Okay... way too close. Breathe.
terrain.2.speaker: pilot
terrain.2.heard: Oh my God, okay, okay, way too close. Breathe.

low.1.text: You're so low I can see the treetops moving. Show-off.
low.1.speaker: wing
low.1.heard: You're so low I can see the tree taps moving. Show off.

land.2.text: And... we're down. Nice and soft. What a flight.
land.2.speaker: pilot
land.2.heard: and, or down, nice and soft. Huh, what a flight.

land.3.text: Smooth landing, lead. I'd give it a nine. Maybe a nine and a half.
land.3.speaker: wing
land.3.heard: Smooth landing, lead. I give it a 9. Maybe a 9 and a half.

cruise.2.text: Coffee would be nice right about now. Long leg, this one.
cruise.2.speaker: pilot
cruise.2.heard: Coffee would be nice right about now. Long leg, this one.

cruise.4.text: Lead, if we meet aliens, I'm doing the talking. You've got a terrible radio voice.
cruise.4.speaker: wing
cruise.4.heard: Lead, if we meet aliens, I'm doing the talking. You've got a terrible radio voice.

react.joy.2.text: Woo! Best job in the world, I'm telling you.
react.joy.2.speaker: pilot
react.joy.2.heard: Woo, best job in the world, I'm telling you. Hmm.

place.eiffel.text: There's the Eiffel Tower! Looks like a little toy from up here.
place.eiffel.speaker: wing
place.eiffel.heard: There's the Eiffel Tower. Looks like a little toy from up here.

place.dubai.text: Burj Khalifa, eight hundred and twenty-eight metres. And we're higher.
place.dubai.speaker: wing
place.dubai.heard: Burj Khalifa 828 meters, and we're higher.
